assign.request: Refine the ui-test skill until it gives usable feedback; figure out how to compact ext/Playground so any layout is reachable in as few clicks as possible; propose clickable edge resizers with a + inserter; the tool does not teach flex or grid.
steps: drive one layout end-to-end to verify the count

log.msg: Baseline jank sweep ran FIRST, before the sibling pg-interactions edits could land. Fixture: 3-level doc in own slug pgmm-ux (root Flex row, 3 Flex columns, 2 Boxes each = 10 .pg-node). Every node hovered from a neutral point, every rect diffed.

BASELINE RESULT: hovering ANY of the 10 nodes moves 9-10 of 10 nodes. Hovering the root: 9 nodes move, columns lose 10px width, max single shift 22px. Hovering any non-root node: all 10 move, the whole .pg-viewport grows +30px TALL (152 -> 182) and columns still lose 10px wide. Max per-node delta 22px x / 30px h; total absolute shift 189px (root) and 309px (every other node). Return-to-neutral restores the baseline exactly, so the layout is not corrupted - it breathes on every hover.

CLICK TABLE - gesture = one click, shift-click, or one field entry. Start = freshly opened doc (seed: Flex column page, pad 2em, gap 1em; BoxA width 10em height 6em; BoxB grow 1 height 6em), root ALREADY selected on open (swap sets selected = doc.id - verified).
L1 header/content/footer (3 bands, full width, middle grows) = 6: select A, A width fill, select B, B width fill, toolbar + (adds C into root, auto-selected), C width fill.
L2 sidebar + content = 1: direction row. The seed IS this layout - A is a 10em fixed flank, B has grow 1. The only layout the fixed seed box helps.

L3 3-across equal = 7: direction row, toolbar + (C auto-selected), C width fill, select box1 via tree, width fill, select box2 via tree, width fill. DRIVEN end to end and asserted after every gesture; final rendered widths 129/129/129. Counted 7 == driven 7.

L4 2x3 card grid = 8: type grid, columns field 1fr 1fr 1fr, toolbar + x4, select A, A width fill. (toolbar + lands beside a non-container selection, i.e. back into root - so four adds in a row work without reselecting.)

L5 holy grail = 16: select A, A width fill, select B, type flex, B width fill, + (nav into B), nav width fixed, type 12em, + (main), main width fill, + (aside), aside width fixed, type 12em, select root, + (footer C), C width fill. TOTAL across five layouts = 38.

JANK ROOT CAUSE: .pg-add is an in-flow last child (canvas.js Canvas.render) revealed by .pg-node:hover > .pg-add. CSS :hover matches every ancestor, so pointing at one leaf reveals up to 3 + at once. Measured 20x30px in a row parent, 418x22px in a column parent - real flow space either way. .pg-resize-handle already solves this with position:absolute (its own comment: reserves zero flow space BY CONSTRUCTION); the + never got the same treatment.

The jank blocks automation, not just the eye: once a nodes parent is a row, its + is a narrow strip that reflows out from under the pointer as it appears - Playwright hover timed out at the full 30s. Proof that the fix is not cosmetic.
Sidebar overflows the window: with a Flex selected at 1280x900, the align seg buttons measure at y=914 and y=943 - below the viewport, unreachable without scrolling.

Test-document discipline held: all work in slug pgmm-ux, deleted at the end (delete_current -> true). public/data/playground/ now holds only index.json, layouts, pgmm-interact.json (the sibling agents), untitled.json, untitled-2.json. No owner document was ever gestured on.

Six evidence lines appended to .claude/skills/ui-test/improvements.md - the biggest: drive.mjs crashes the whole run on a mid-run navigation because rects() is outside the per-step try/catch, and a sibling agent saving a file under public/ triggers LiveReload and does exactly that. Lost three runs to it; workaround is watch: [] plus re-acquiring module state in every eval.

assign.outcome:
**A baseline that names the bug, a click table whose two numbers agree, and a one-rule replacement for the canvas chrome.**

- **Jank baseline (pre-edit — the before-picture wave 3 re-runs):** hovering ANY of 10 nodes in a 3-level document moves 9–10 of them. Any non-root node grows the viewport **+30px tall** and shrinks every column **10px wide**; worst single shift 22px x / 30px h. Cause: `.pg-add` is an **in-flow** last child revealed by `.pg-node:hover`, and `:hover` matches every ancestor, so one leaf reveals three `+` at once. `.pg-resize-handle` already solved this with `position: absolute`; the `+` never got the same treatment. Plan + numbers: [jank-sweep-plan.json](./jank-sweep-plan.json)
- **It blocks automation, not just the eye** — once a parent is a row the `+` reflows out from under the pointer as it appears; Playwright `hover` times out at the full 30s.
- **Click table: 38 gestures today across the five canonical layouts, 16 under the proposal.** 3-across-equal counted **7** and driven **7** — asserted after every gesture, ending at three 129px columns.
- **The proposal:** [proposal.md](./proposal.md) — one rule (*an edge inserts a sibling that way; the parent is made to flow that way if it does not*), so **direction is never a separate gesture**. Five targets per node (4 edges + centre); sibling-before/after, wrap-into-row/column and section all fall out of it. Plus: seed both boxes `fill` (the fixed 10em seed box alone costs 8 of the 38), delete the in-flow `+`, 4 toolbar buttons and 3 sidebar fields.
- **Learnability:** attribute the change in the readout (`flex-direction: row  ← you clicked the right edge`), and put `justify`/`align` chips **on the axis they control** — the one thing a sidebar column can never teach.

![three equal cards in 7 gestures](./three-across-7-gestures.png)

- **ui-test skill:** 6 evidence lines in `.claude/skills/ui-test/improvements.md`. Biggest: `drive.mjs` **crashes the whole run** on a mid-run navigation (`rects()` sits outside the per-step try/catch), and a sibling agent saving under `public/` triggers LiveReload and does exactly that — three runs lost. Proved workarounds: `watch: []`, and re-acquire module state in every `eval` instead of parking it on `window`. Also: `hover ancestor` → `hover "ancestor>child"` → `down`/`up` drives hover-revealed elements with **no coordinates**, beating the skill's own probe-and-aim workaround.
- **Left:** the other four layouts are counted, not driven — the sibling was editing `canvas.js`/`toolbar.js` live, so only the counted-vs-driven pair the brief asked for was verified. Grid stays 2 gestures: a template is information, not a click.
